plugins.whimbox_adapter.config.Info.Base: Shared and Independent currently both use each account's page settings and write them to Whimbox at run time; they do not share one base configuration across this managed script. Native uses Whimbox's own configuration: no writes with configuration overrides off; when on, this account's panel fields temporarily override it and are restored after the task. Configure the LLM model, keybinds, and routes in Whimbox.

plugins.whimbox_adapter.config.Update.Ta: Check and install the official stable Whimbox backend before each batch, then start tasks. If checking or downloading fails, warn and continue after verifying the current installation. Stop if installation is incomplete. Only the backend is updated, not the app.
